chapters.title: Dummy head for the level below

frames.caption: Dummy head for the level below — O(n) time, O(1) extra space. Input: connect(root=tree (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
head = dummy.next — head moves to (2) (first node of the level below)

head = dummy.next — head moves to (4) (first node of the level below)
